hero.title: FEWER MESSAGES.
hero.body: Bring requests, conversations and dates together in one place. Even when the first contact happens outside Cuebooker.
hero.note: For independent DJs, managers and agencies.

problem.label: THE PROBLEM
problem.title: Your bookings are everywhere.
problem.body: A date change on WhatsApp. Terms over email. A proposal on Instagram. Between calls and notes, the next step can get lost.
problem.solution: Every request keeps its context, conversation, date and status in one place. You still make the decisions; Cuebooker keeps the process organised.

work.label: 01 / HOW IT WORKS
work.title: From proposal to confirmed date.
work.body: Capture what comes in, review the context and keep the next step in sight. You decide when to confirm.
descriptions: Add an opportunity that starts elsewhere or receive a request through your profile.
Review the date, terms and contact before moving forward.
Keep the next move and holds alongside the conversation.
Confirm when everything fits. The date stays in your calendar.
work.note: Illustrative example. No messages are sent and no bookings are created.
work.confirmed: 18 Oct · Booking confirmed in this example

seo.title: Cuebooker | Fewer messages. More bookings.
seo.description: Organise requests, conversations, follow-ups and dates in one place. A booking workspace for independent DJs, managers and agencies.

features.label: 02 / PRODUCT
features.title: The context, the next step and the date.
features.body: Your workspace organises the work. Commercial decisions stay yours.

items.title: Requests and conversations
items.text: Keep the contact, terms and history of each opportunity together in one booking.

items.title: Follow-ups and holds
items.text: Record the next move and hold a provisional date without treating it as a confirmation.

items.title: Calendar and availability
items.text: Review bookings, holds and private availability blocks before committing a date.

audience.label: 03 / WHO IT’S FOR
audience.title: Your project. Your way of working.

items.title: I’m a DJ
items.text: Manage proposals, conversations and dates without relying on memory. Share your profile when you’re ready.

items.title: I’m a manager/agency
items.text: Keep each artist’s context and coordinate follow-ups on opportunities from one workspace.

audience.note: Choose how you work after signing up. Agency capabilities are still evolving.

extensions.label: 04 / BEYOND BOOKING
extensions.title: A space for what represents you.

items.title: Public profile
items.text: Your introduction and an entry point for requests. Promoters don’t need an account.

items.title: CUE Passport
items.text: A view of your journey, connected to your booking activity.

items.title: CUE ID
items.text: A visual identity for your artistic project. The character creator is still in development.

closing.title: DON’T LET A DATE SLIP AWAY.
closing.body: Give every proposal a place. Keep control of what happens next.
closing.footer: Made for the people behind the sound.
